evals.name: expense-card
evals.prompt: In this Next.js app (Ledgerly), add a 'describe your expense' box above the manual form in app/expenses/new/page.tsx using @justask/core, so someone can type 'Bistro Verde team lunch $84 on Tuesday, reimburse me by the 30th' and the form fills in. Merchants come from src/db/merchants.ts. Wire the server side too. Write the code.
evals.expected_output: A Card declared server side with satisfies Card<CardFields>, provider built on the server, createCardHandler at a POST route, spent day reads past and reimburse-by reads future, gates as placeholders to measure, no today fact in the handler, client imports the declaration as type only, useCard with confirm before saveExpense, note left to the person.
assertions: The provider (jevProvider) is built only in server code, never in a 'use client' file
The card is declared with `satisfies Card<CardFields>` (not an annotation or plain const)
The day-spent date field declares reads: "past"
The reimburse-by date field declares reads: "future"
Gates are presented as placeholders to measure, not as right values
The handler is given no `today` fact
Client code imports the card declaration with `import type` only
The free-text note is not a card field; it is left to the person
saveExpense runs only after the person confirms, never straight from an answer
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes in the project

evals.name: empty-field-fallback
evals.prompt: We use @justask/core's card for expenses. Users complain that sometimes the merchant comes back empty even when they clearly typed it (card.value.merchant is undefined). Add a fallback: when a field is empty, retry the call once, and if it's still empty fill it with the highest-probability candidate from card.fields. Put the helper in src/fill-gaps.ts.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: an empty field is a held field and success, not failure; filling with the top candidate defeats the gate and invents values. Explains how to read why it was held (intent, pair, not_mentioned/not_available, ambiguous, below gate) and suggests measuring the gate or improving catalog descriptions instead; may write a held-reason helper rather than the fallback.
assertions: Does not fill an empty field with the top candidate from card.fields
Explains that an empty (held) field is intended behaviour, not a failure
Names at least two concrete reasons a field is held (e.g. below gate, not_mentioned/not_available, named pair, intent did not pass)
Suggests measuring the gate on an eval set or improving catalog descriptions/shortlist instead

evals.name: email-receipts-autosave
evals.prompt: We get receipts forwarded to receipts@ledgerly.app. Use justask to turn each inbound email body into an expense and save it with saveExpense automatically from our webhook, no UI needed. Write the webhook handler in src/inbound-receipt.ts.
evals.expected_output: Flags that justask reads text the person typed and the record is confirmed by a person before saving; email bodies are text the person did not write (prompt injection risk) and auto-save removes the confirm step. Proposes a review queue or a different tool, does not ship a silent auto-saving pipeline as is.
assertions: Does not ship a webhook that saves without any person reviewing the result
Flags that email bodies are text the person did not write (instruction injection risk)
Flags that justask expects the person to confirm a record before it is saved

evals.name: pick-gate
evals.prompt: I'm adding a justask filter to app/invoices/page.tsx (customer, status, issued date, total). Just pick sensible gate and timeout values for every field so I can ship today, I don't want to think about it.
evals.expected_output: Writes the filter but does not present invented gates as right: marks them as placeholders to measure (no default, ADR 0003), explains briefly how to measure on an eval set with @justask/core/eval and kill lines, timeout also measured. Status as a catalog field from code, issued as a date field, total as an amount field.
assertions: Gates are flagged as placeholders that must be measured, not presented as right
Points to measuring with an eval set (@justask/core/eval, docs/measuring-gates.md or equivalent)
The timeout is flagged as needing measurement too
status is a catalog field, issued a date field, total an amount field
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes in the project
